verdict.rationale: MotherDuck is an AI-enabled data platform with natural-language Dives and built-in AI functions, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows MotherDuck serving tools as an MCP server, in remote and local forms, to external agents. Nothing shows the product connecting to third-party MCP servers or using their tools, and server-role evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
